title: Thai-Style Cabbage Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and healthy stir-fry made with cabbage, aromatic spices, and a hint of Thai flavors.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced cabbage and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar (if using) and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the cabbage is tender but still crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
